en.title: Neon Requiem — Connected Rain and the Forgotten Server
en.premise: In a world where consciousness backups are everyday, young memory cleaner Kai collects fragments of memory. One day he discovers a data that shouldn't exist—a virtual shop that opens only on rainy days. Inside, he finds unfinished emotional data of a lost lover. The unclassifiable "noise" begins to erode the boundary between reality and simulation, and Kai becomes entangled in a conspiracy to fix the world's bugs.

zh.title: Neon Requiem — 连接的雨与被遗忘的服务器
zh.premise: 在意识备份已成为日常的世界里，年轻的记忆清理者凯收集记忆碎片。某天，他发现了一个不该存在的数据——只有雨天才会开启的虚拟商店。店内，他获得了已逝恋人未完成的情感数据。无法定义的“噪音”开始侵蚀现实与虚拟的边界，凯卷入了修复世界错误的阴谋。
